<thought>In the 13C NMR data, signals in the upfield region (≈10‑30 ppm) correspond to typical alkyl methyl carbons. The spectrum shows three such peaks at 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm. Additionally, a peak at 57.20 ppm is characteristic of a methyl carbon attached to an electronegative atom (e.g., a methoxy group). Therefore, the molecule contains four distinct methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
